"""PAD-711 fixture: an expand-only revision; the guard is silent on it.

Additive upgrade(): nullable columns, a NOT NULL column with a server default, a new table, an
index, a nullable relaxation. Its downgrade() drops everything, as a downgrade does, and the guard
never reads downgrade(). Read as text by test_pad711_expand_contract_guard.py, never applied.
"""
import sqlalchemy as sa
from alembic import op

revision = "pad711expand"
down_revision = None


def upgrade():
    op.add_column("lesson", sa.Column("venue_id", sa.Integer(), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("lesson", sa.Column("is_open", sa.Boolean(), nullable=False, server_default=sa.false()))
    op.create_table(
        "venue",
        sa.Column("id", sa.Integer(), primary_key=True),
        sa.Column("name", sa.String(120), nullable=False),
    )
    op.create_index("ix_lesson_venue_id", "lesson", ["venue_id"])
    op.alter_column("player", "phone", nullable=True)
    op.execute("UPDATE lesson SET is_open = true WHERE starts_at > now()")


def downgrade():
    op.drop_index("ix_lesson_venue_id", table_name="lesson")
    op.drop_table("venue")
    op.drop_column("lesson", "is_open")
    op.drop_column("lesson", "venue_id")
